It has abundant applications in a variety of computer vision tasks, such as image compression [1], outline and cartoon creation colorization [2], [3], and re- mote sensing images colorization [4], [5]. Besides, the colorization problem also inherits the c hallenges of image enhancement, such as changes in il- lumination, variations in viewpoints, and occlusions.
